messages.author: e498014918cd05fb
messages.subject: Help with Installing Rattle on Mac OS X Lion 10.7.2
parts:
Dear all, I have some problems using rattle after upgrading to Lion.
After typing "rattle()", the following message shows up:

(R:1254): Gtk-WARNING **: Unknown property: GtkMenuBar.ubuntu-local
Error: attempt to apply non-function
In addition: Warning message:
In method(obj, ...) : Unknown internal child: selection
Rattle timestamp (for the message above): 2011-11-28 13:58:57
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

I have also checked rattleInfo():

> rattleInfo()
Rattle: version 2.6.14 cran 2.6.14
R: version 2.14.0 (2011-10-31) (Revision 57496)

Sysname: Darwin
Release: 11.2.0
Version: Darwin Kernel Version 11.2.0: Tue Aug 9 20:54:00 PDT 2011;
root:xnu-1699.24.8~1/RELEASE_X86_64
Nodename: Boxuan.local
Machine: x86_64
Login: Scoriger
User: Scoriger
Effective_user: Scoriger

Installed Dependencies
RGtk2: version 2.20.19
colorspace: version 1.1-0
e1071: version 1.6
foreign: version 0.8-47
gWidgetsRGtk2: version 0.0-77
Matrix: version 1.0-2
nnet: version 7.3-1
randomForest: version 4.6-2
RGtk2Extras: version 0.5.0
rpart: version 3.1-50
survival: version 2.36-10

That was 13 packages.


Does anyone know the possible causes of this? Your help will be
greatly appreciated! Thanks in advance!

messages.subject: Re: Help with Installing Rattle on Mac OS X Lion 10.7.2

Thanks for the confirmation Jim.

Knowing others are also having this problem is very useful.

I'm thinking it might be a NAMESPACE issue (new in R 2.14.0) but only
affecting Mac OS/X.

A work around for now might be:

> library(rattle)
> set.cursor <- rattle:::set.cursor
> rattle()

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: [FIXED] Re: Help with Installing Rattle on Mac OS X Lion 10.7.2
parts:
Thanks to everyone reporting this error with the latest install of R,
rattle, RGtk2, on Mac OSX - your assistance and patience has been much
appreciated.

It seems that loading the rattle.ui file (the user interface
definition) on the Mac OSX fails after any warnings. As a result, the
interface does not get built and we see the errors that are being
reported (from set.cursor() in the first instance).

A solution has been implemented and has been released as Rattle
version 2.6.15. It is currently making its way to CRAN. In the
meantime, you can download
http://togaware.com.au/access/rattle_2.6.15.tar.gz and install from
the R command line:

> install.packages("rattle_2.6.15.tar.gz", repos=NULL, type="source")

Regards,
Graham

parts:
Thanks a lot!!! The new version is perfect.

On 12月4日, 上午7時19分, Graham Williams <Graham.Willi...@togaware.com>
wrote:

> Thanks to everyone reporting this error with the latest install of R,
> rattle, RGtk2, on Mac OSX - your assistance and patience has been much
> appreciated.
>
> It seems that loading the rattle.ui file (the user interface
> definition) on the Mac OSX fails after any warnings. As a result, the
> interface does not get built and we see the errors that are being
> reported (from set.cursor() in the first instance).
>
> A solution has been implemented and has been released as Rattle
> version 2.6.15. It is currently making its way to CRAN. In the
> meantime, you can downloadhttp://togaware.com.au/access/rattle_2.6.15.tar.gzand install from

> the R command line:
>
> > install.packages("rattle_2.6.15.tar.gz", repos=NULL, type="source")
>
> Regards,
> Graham
